description: Team Eclipse is a Peru-based, multidisciplinary team blending engineering and 3D (Three.js/React), NASA data research (NSSDCA, mission reports, 3D Resources), narrative design (FACT vs. VOICE) and accessible bilingual UX to tell the stories of abandoned lunar and Martian hardware. Interests: space history, 3D visualization, edutainment, open data, accessibility. Looking for: 3D artists, writers, educators, audio designers, data scientists, accessibility testers and translators.
